page.heading: Skills
page.subtitle: Reusable review rules attached to agents. Each = a type, a description, and a Markdown body.

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Import a skill from a file, a URL, or the community catalog.

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import from a file, a URL, or search vetted community skills

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: Pasted content is wrapped as untrusted data — never executed as instructions.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side, stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

community.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

preview.untrustedNotice: This skill came from an untrusted source. Its body is stored as data (delimiter-wrapped) and must be vetted before it is enabled for an agent.
preview.descriptionHint: This is the skill's interface — write it as a direct instruction to the reviewing agent ("Flag X when Y"), not a summary of what it does.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.

evals.body: Skill-level eval runs land in a later lesson. For now, attach this skill to an agent and run it on a real PR to see its effect.

stats.noAgents: Not linked to any agent yet.

versions.title: Version history
versions.restored: Restored v{version} as the new current version.

context.heading: Project context
context.caption: The full text of each attached document is injected at run time — this preview shows only paths and token counts.
context.noRepo: Select a repo to attach project-context documents.
context.empty: No documents discovered for this repo yet.
context.orderHint: Order matters — this is the order documents are injected into the prompt. Changes save as you make them.

drawer.truncated: Truncated to the same slice a review run would inject.
